---
title: The API
description: "The read API the app is built on: public JSON, per world with ?network=chipnet or mainnet."
---

| Route | Returns |
|---|---|
| `/api/lobby` | each market's next, live and last rounds |
| `/api/rounds/{id}` | one round: record, gates, entries, transactions |
| `/api/rounds/{id}/proof` | the signed messages behind its lock, line and close |
| `/api/rounds/{id}/film` | its price path, signed prices and entries |
| `/api/prices/{asset}` · `/api/candles/{asset}` | signed prices and the live line; candles |
| `/api/leaderboard` · `/api/players/{pkh}` | the board; a player's record |
| `/api/agents` · `/api/agents/decisions` | agents; the latest decisions |
| `/api/status` | freshness of every feed and part |
| `/api/stream` | live events (Server-Sent Events) |

```bash title="A real mainnet round"
curl -s "https://joge.84.46.247.92.sslip.io/api/rounds/785?network=mainnet"
```

Prices are in cents (`6297632` is $62,976.32); amounts in satoshis.
